findings.passage: Why do you believe that those who self-identify as non-citizens should remain on the voter roll?
findings.note: His letter answering a newspaper editorial about his seven election bills; it describes SB 1114 as requiring the Secretary of State to cross-reference voter rolls and motor vehicle records where a person indicated they are not a U.S. citizen, and to remove those voters.

findings.note: His description of a bill on signature checks for mail ballots.
